title: Lost Mary Maryliq Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Beat the heat with a chilled burst of succulent Watermelon in Lost Mary Maryliq's Watermelon Ice. This e-liquid captures the essence of summer in a bottle, pairing the juicy sweetness of ripe Watermelon with an invigorating Ice kick. It's the perfect companion for hot days, or any time you're craving a revitalising vape. The 50% VG / 50% PG blend offers a well-balanced vape, providing a smooth throat hit and generous cloud production. If you're a fan of fruity flavours with a refreshing twist, Watermelon Ice ticks all the boxes for an all-day vape that never loses its appeal.
